adds.title: Runaways S3#1
adds.text: Dale shows Gert how to control Old Lace better, then lets the two of them go.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Old Lace's creators. Dale helps Gert control her.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: The dinosaur Dale and Stacey built. Dale helps Gert control her.
adds.evidence: Smoke and Mirrors (S3#1): Dale lets Gert go and teaches her to control Old Lace; Gert links to Lace's senses and Lace runs into a tree.

adds.title: Runaways S3#2
adds.text: Trapped together in Jonah's algorithm, Chase finds Karolina and they escape it together.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: A friend who escapes Jonah's algorithm with Karolina.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: A friend who escapes Jonah's algorithm with Chase.
adds.evidence: The Great Escape (S3#2): Chase and Janet seep into each other's algorithm and reunite with Karolina; Chase and Karolina escape while Janet stays behind.

adds.title: Runaways S3#8
adds.text: In the Dark Dimension, AWOL and his men hunt the Runaways and go after Nico first.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: The cop Nico made vanish, who hunts her in the Dark Dimension.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: The girl AWOL hunts in the Dark Dimension.
adds.evidence: Devil's Torture Chamber (S3#8): AWOL, sent to the Dark Dimension by Nico's spell, parades the streets for prisoners, finds the Runaways and tells his men to get Nico first; Quinton saves them.

adds.title: Runaways S3#8
adds.text: Chase joins the rescue that frees Alex from his Dark Dimension prison.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: A friend who helps rescue Alex from the Dark Dimension.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: A friend Chase helps rescue from the Dark Dimension.
adds.evidence: Devil's Torture Chamber (S3#8): the Runaways, with Cloak and Dagger, reach the prison and find Alex, who is happy to see them; Cloak teleports them back to the Hostel.

adds.title: Runaways S3#8
adds.text: Gert joins the rescue that frees Alex from his Dark Dimension prison.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: A friend who helps rescue Alex from the Dark Dimension.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: A friend Gert helps rescue from the Dark Dimension.
adds.evidence: Devil's Torture Chamber (S3#8): the group, including Gert (Ty learns she still cares for Chase on the way), navigates the prison and frees Alex.

adds.title: Runaways S3#8
adds.text: Karolina joins the rescue that frees Alex from his Dark Dimension prison.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: A friend who helps rescue Alex from the Dark Dimension.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: A friend Karolina helps rescue from the Dark Dimension.
adds.evidence: Devil's Torture Chamber (S3#8): Ty and Tandy free Karolina, Chase and Gert from Morgan's coven, and the group goes into the Dark Dimension and frees Alex.

adds.title: Runaways S3#10
adds.text: Alex and Molly join the trip back in time to catch an evil future Alex and save Gert.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: The youngest of Alex's fellow runaways. Travels back in time with him.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: A friend and fellow runaway who travels back in time with Molly.
adds.evidence: Cheat the Gallows (S3#10): Future Chase gathers everyone but his past self, including Alex and Molly, to travel back and stop Future Alex and rescue Gert; afterwards Molly and the others hurry Alex up to go to breakfast.

adds.title: Runaways S3#8
adds.text: With Tyrone and Tandy, Nico frees Gert from Morgan's coven and leads her into the Dark Dimension to find Alex.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: A friend Nico frees from Morgan's coven.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: A friend who frees Gert from Morgan's coven.
adds.evidence: Devil's Torture Chamber (S3#8): Ty and Tandy take Nico to rescue her captured friends, then the group returns to the Dark Dimension to locate Alex.

adds.title: Runaways S3#8
adds.text: With Tyrone and Tandy, Nico frees Chase from Morgan's coven and leads him into the Dark Dimension to find Alex.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: A friend Nico frees from Morgan's coven.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: A friend who frees Chase from Morgan's coven.
adds.evidence: Devil's Torture Chamber (S3#8): Ty and Tandy take Nico to rescue her captured friends, Chase among them, then the group returns to the Dark Dimension to locate Alex.

adds.title: Runaways S3#2
adds.text: Molly sneaks up on Jonah while he fights Nico, helping take him down.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: The youngest runaway, who helps Nico take down Jonah.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: A friend Molly helps against Jonah.
adds.evidence: The Great Escape (S3#2): Molly finds the Magistrate fighting Nico and sneaks up on him, knocking him out with Xavin's help.

adds.title: Runaways S3#10
adds.text: Karolina travels back in time with the others to save Gert from dying in the fight with Morgan.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: A friend Karolina helps save from death.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: A friend who travels back in time to save Gert.
adds.evidence: Cheat the Gallows (S3#10): three years after Gert's death, Future Chase gathers everyone, Karolina included, and they travel back to the fight with Morgan and rescue Gert.

adds.title: Runaways S3#7
adds.text: When a Corvus phone puts Molly in a trance, Karolina breaks the phone and frees her.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: A friend Karolina frees from a Corvus phone's trance.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: A friend who frees Molly from a Corvus phone's trance.
adds.evidence: Left-Hand Path (S3#7): Karolina destroys the Corvus phone and saves Molly, who is horrified she almost hurt her friends.

adds.title: Runaways S3#7
adds.text: Under a Corvus phone's trance, Molly throws Chase into a wall, and he knocks the phone from her hand so it can be broken.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: A friend who attacks Chase while in a Corvus phone's trance.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: A friend who knocks the Corvus phone from Molly's hand.
adds.evidence: Left-Hand Path (S3#7): Chase tries to grab the phone and Molly pushes him into a wall; Chase hits the phone out of her hand with a metal rod and Karolina breaks it.

adds.title: Runaways S3#7
adds.text: Sensing a dark force, Tyrone teleports himself and Tandy to Los Angeles, where they agree to help Nico.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Tandy's best friend. Takes her to Los Angeles to help Nico.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Tyrone's best friend. Goes with him to Los Angeles to help Nico.
adds.evidence: Left-Hand Path (S3#7) and Devil's Torture Chamber (S3#8): Cloak senses a dark force and teleports Dagger to the Hostel; they agree to help Nico rescue her friends and Alex.

owner_calls.question: Old Lace and the Yorkes are enemies from S2 (Dale and Stacey tranquilize her to track Gert). In S3#1 Dale teaches Gert to control Old Lace. Keep the new stage as ally, or keep enemy as the through-line?
owner_calls.evidence: Smoke and Mirrors: Dale shows Gert how to control Old Lace better; in S3#2 the Magistrate's Wife, inside Stacey, attacks and Old Lace headbutts her.
